title: Arrow For Fluid | 流体流向箭头
description:

add arrow for water and lava.
body:
# Arrow For Fluid
~~Do you also need some arrow for the water and lava fluid like I do?~~

## Features
Add arrow for water and lava.Like gallery.

## Installation
1. Download the resource pack file (.zip).
2. Open Minecraft, go to "Options" > "Resource Packs" > "Open Resource Pack Folder".
3. Place the downloaded file into the folder.
4. Enable the resource pack in-game.


# 流体流向箭头
~~你是否也跟我一样需要简易查看流体的流向？~~

## 概述
对水和岩浆流体添加了指向箭头。

## 安装方法
1. 下载资源包文件 (.zip)。
2. 打开 Minecraft，进入“选项” > “资源包” > “打开资源包文件夹”。
3. 将下载的文件放入文件夹中。
4. 在游戏中启用该资源包即可。
